label: Conveyor
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; npm install -g @openai/codex; mkdir -p ~/.local/bin; curl -fsSL -o ~/.local/bin/jq https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/jq-1.8.1/jq-linux-amd64; echo "020468de7539ce70ef1bceaf7cde2e8c4f2ca6c3afb84642aabc5c97d9fc2a0d  $HOME/.local/bin/jq" | sha256sum -c -; chmod +x ~/.local/bin/jq; curl -fsSL -o ~/.local/micromamba https://github.com/mamba-org/micromamba-releases/releases/download/2.0.5-0/micromamba-linux-64; echo "cdf5a2e18d213617b6c5c32d8763b4e8fc05f8173b4f4017997683cb984357eb  $HOME/.local/micromamba" | sha256sum -c -; chmod +x ~/.local/micromamba; ~/.local/micromamba create -y -q -r ~/.local/mamba -p ~/.local/git -c conda-forge git=2.56.1; rm -rf ~/.local/mamba ~/.local/micromamba; ln -sf ~/.local/git/bin/git ~/.local/bin/git
preflight: claude --version && codex --version && v=$(jq --version) && n=$(printf %s "$v" | grep -oE '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | head -n 1) && { [ -n "$n" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' 1.8 "$n" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = 1.8 ] || { echo "jq in the container is $v: Conveyor needs jq 1.8 or newer" >&2; exit 1; }; } && v=$(git --version) && n=$(printf %s "$v" | grep -oE '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | head -n 1) && { [ -n "$n" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' 2.36 "$n" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = 2.36 ] || { echo "git in the container is $v: Conveyor needs git 2.36 or newer" >&2; exit 1; }; }
